en.sim0.footer: 001: sweep 25–45 kHz → pair resonance → 002: half-bridge + watts (model sketch, not lab data)

pair resonance ≈ 40.1 kHz,
peak width ~1 kHz if Q~40 (assumed)
en.sim2.title: Model: pair Δf dominates power (10 W drive, η≤40% assumed, Q~40)
en.sim2.note:
takeaway: buy Langevins from one batch
and always start with a sweep; watts are targets until exp. 002
en.sim3.title: Mode B: the plate is most transparent at thickness resonances

en.sim4.title: Receiver budget vs target bands (not measured — stage 2+ goals)

en.sim5.note.fast: ring-down eats the edges: the eye closes — faster is mode B territory
